title: AI Agent Rate Limits: A Practical Retry Strategy for 429 Errors
excerpt: Forty parallel agents, one shared quota, and a six-hour wall of HTTP 429s taught me the difference between a rate limit you retry and a spend cap you don't.
seo_title: AI Agent Rate Limits: A Practical Retry Strategy
meta_description: Learn how to fix AI agent rate limit errors with exponential backoff, token-bucket concurrency limits, and tested idempotent retry code in Python.
social_message:
My overnight AI agent run hit six straight hours of HTTP 429s.

Forty agents fanning out meant 20+ model calls each, way past the rate limit before a single retry even fired. Here's the exponential backoff, token-bucket concurrency cap, and idempotent retry pattern that fixed it, tested in Python.

Read the full guide 👉 https://www.firstevolvenextscale.com/ai-agent-rate-limits/
